title: Decision roadmap
description: An ordered set of frames from the decision library, at packages/<function>/roadmaps/<id>.json. A roadmap reuses frames and holds no answers: installing it (naive roadmap install <id>) proposes each step's decisions open, and the founder decides. Versioned like a package; a venture that switches roadmaps keeps the decisions already made. schema/check-roadmap.mjs rejects cycles, unknown frames, steps with no decider and one-way doors delegated away from the founder.

source.description: Where the ordering comes from, such as a public playbook it was distilled from

depends_on.description: Step ids that must be decided first

door.description: one-way: hard to undo, so the founder decides it

decided_by.description: The role that decides, under the delegation suite; founder for every one-way door

merged_by.description: The role that merges the decided work

requires.description: Evidence or lint checks that must pass first
